turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi, it's your tenant from flat 5B. I'm afraid the hot water stopped again this morning.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Again? I'm sorry. When did it happen before?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: This is the third time this month. The plumber came on Monday and last Friday, and both times it worked for a day or two, then stopped again.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's strange. Is it only in the mornings?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Mostly, yes, which is a problem, because I need to shower before work. I leave at half past eight.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I see. The plumber can come again tomorrow at eight. Or I can get the heater replaced on Saturday, but someone has to be at home from nine to one.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: The same fix hasn't worked twice, so I think a new heater is better. Saturday is fine. I'll be at home.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Okay, I'll arrange it. A new heater on Saturday, between nine and one.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks. And could you ask them to call me before they come?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. I'll give them your number.
